messages:
lina: Quick sync 1: microthread plan for the post-launch push. We want: 1) X thread (4 tweets) with benchmark hook, 2) LinkedIn long post, 3) influencer seeding (5 folks) to amplify. Need hero + 2 caption variants + tracking links by Tue EOD.

chris: copied. Who are the 5 influencers? I can ping legal about paid amplification rules. Also we should use separate UTM for seeded links. Suggest utm_campaign=llm-launch-seed & utm_source=influencer_name.

lina: @chris added a provisional list in the doc: @matt_devops, @k_ux, @ai_julia, @sanjay_ops, @nora_growth. Chris can you run legal check? Also want to A/B test CTA phrasing: "Sign up" vs "See the demo".

izzy: Draft captions: A) "See how we pushed 31% cost down with smart batching 1 Register: <link>?utm_campaign=llm-launch-seed&utm_source=org-social" B) "Engineering playbook + demo: reduce latency and cost. RSVP: <link>" Feedback: keep A tighter for X, B for LI.

ana: Recommend keeping the embargoed benchmark sentence out of pre-launch seeded posts. Only share the one-liner after the webinar recording goes live. Pre-seed: tease % improvement as "major savings" not numeric. Post-recording: drop the 31% stat.

lina: Good call. We'll tease: "major cost savings" pre, numeric post. @ops-bot can you queue the scheduled posts once assets are locked?

ops-bot: Queue request received. Please confirm times. Proposed schedule:
```
- X thread (day-of) 09:00 PT
- X single follow-up (recording) 11:30 PT
- LinkedIn long post (day-of) 08:00 PT
- Seeded influencer posts staggered between 09:05-09:20 PT
```
status: pending approval

chris: Legal OK for organic mentions, flagged paid amplification paperwork needed for 2 influencers. I'll loop in legal now. Also I'll generate unique tracking links: list attached in doc.

izzy: I'll upload hero variations (X/LI sizes) and two caption sets to Figma by Mon noon. Also prepping thread breakdown (tweet 1 hook, tweet 2 quick stat (tease), tweet 3 demo CTA, tweet 4 community CTA + link).

lina: Final asks: keep A/B test for CTA in seeded links (50/50), tag seeds with influencer_source param, and set conversion tracking for "request demo" and "register". We'll lock schedule after assets + legal sign-off. Thanks :raised_hands:
